identity.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][closeout] Delete terminal reconciliation and receipt-authority machinery

review_prompts: Can any supported surface still write or reconcile a tracked terminal projection or receipt?
Does legacy receipt and phase deserialization remain read-only and outcome-compatible?
Did deletion accidentally weaken exact-head finish, status, or cleanup safety?
Are all active manifests, schemas, tests, and docs aligned without a hidden wrapper?

findings.summary: A public direct-merge API remained after the standalone binary was deleted.
Active operator documentation still advertised deleted merge and closeout binaries.
Whole-change added and net-deleted evidence totals were off by one line.

residual_risk: The read-only review did not execute a live GitHub merge; full locked tests prove the preserved sequence and publication will exercise the live integration path.
